case-sara.text: [Softly] You should have seen the way she looked at me; I felt so small.
case-sara.suggestion: What is it like inside when you feel that small?

case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] At brunch I kept saying I was fine, but I could tell I was trying too hard.
case-sara.suggestion: When you notice yourself trying that hard to seem fine, what feeling is closest?

case-sara.text: [Angry] I was angry he forgot my birthday, and then I felt silly for caring.
case-sara.suggestion: When you call yourself silly for caring, what feeling is underneath that?

case-sara.text: [Softly] I want to ask him why he stopped trying, but I keep telling myself it is pointless.
case-sara.suggestion: When you imagine asking him that, what feeling comes up first?

case-sara.text: [Panicked] Sometimes I delete old photos and then look for them again ten minutes later.
case-sara.suggestion: When you cannot let the photos stay gone, what feeling comes up most strongly?

case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] When someone is kind to me, I suddenly do not know what to do with it.
case-sara.suggestion: When kindness leaves you unsure what to do, what feeling comes up?

case-sara.text: [Softly] I wake up and forget for a second that he is gone, and then it hits me all over again.
case-sara.suggestion: In that first moment of remembering, what feeling arrives before you explain it?

case-sara.text: [Tearful] I feel embarrassed that I am still this sad, like grief should have expired by now.
case-sara.suggestion: When the embarrassment says grief should be over, what sadness is still asking to be noticed?

case-sara.text: [Tearful] Seeing couples at the market makes me leave before I cry.
case-sara.suggestion: When you leave before the tears come, what feeling are you trying not to show?

case-sara.text: [Softly] I cross the street to avoid the cafe we used to call ours.
case-sara.suggestion: When you picture that cafe, what feeling rises before you decide to cross the street?

case-sara.text: [Unsure] I found a restaurant I wanted to try. I nearly booked a table, then closed the page. I can't quite tell what stopped me.
case-sara.suggestion: What happens inside as you imagine going there on your own?

case-sara.text: [Quietly] My friend said I seemed more like myself. I smiled, but something about that stayed with me. I'm not sure what.
case-sara.suggestion: What does hearing 'more like yourself' bring up in you?

case-michael.text: [Tense and angry] When someone corrects one detail, I get angry and embarrassed at the same time.
case-michael.suggestion: What do you notice inside as anger and embarrassment show up together?

case-michael.text: [Defensive] A sigh from my wife makes me assume she has already decided I am wrong.
case-michael.suggestion: When that sigh lands as judgment, what feeling comes first?

case-michael.text: [Tense] My boss praised the team but not me, and I could not stop thinking about it.
case-michael.suggestion: When you replay not being named, what feeling keeps coming back?

case-michael.text: [Tense and angry] I scan meeting rooms for disrespect before I even know who has walked in.
case-michael.suggestion: When you are already scanning for disrespect, what feeling are you bracing for?

case-michael.text: [Defensive] When I apologize to my wife, it feels like I have handed her the win.
case-michael.suggestion: When apologizing feels like losing, what feeling is hardest to stay with?

case-michael.text: [Tense] When I am unsure of an answer in front of the team, I start talking faster so nobody notices.
case-michael.suggestion: What does being unsure in front of the team feel like inside?

case-michael.text: [Tense and angry] I told my wife I was fine, but I was still angry hours later.
case-michael.suggestion: When the anger stays for hours, where do you notice it most?

case-michael.text: [Defensive] I slam doors at home so no one hears me say I was hurt.
case-michael.suggestion: Before the door slams, what feeling is there that is hard to say out loud?

case-michael.text: [Tense] Being told to calm down makes me explode before I hear anything else.
case-michael.suggestion: When those words hit, what feeling comes before the explosion?

case-michael.text: [Ashamed] I hate feeling weak in front of people, like everyone can see I failed.
case-michael.suggestion: When 'weak' shows up in front of people, what feeling comes with being seen?

case-michael.text: [Tense] The report was accepted without any changes. I should have been pleased. Instead I spent the evening checking whether I'd missed something.
case-michael.suggestion: What do you notice in yourself when there is nothing left to correct?

case-michael.text: [Hesitant] My son wanted me to sit with him, not help him fix anything. I stayed, but I didn't really know what to do.
case-michael.suggestion: What is it like for you to be wanted there without a job to do?

case-jason.text: [Quietly] When it is my turn to speak, I lose the sentence and everyone seems to be waiting.
case-jason.suggestion: When everyone seems to be waiting, what feeling shows up?

case-jason.text: [Voice shaking] My voice shakes when I say my name, and then I hear myself sounding pathetic.
case-jason.suggestion: When you hear the shake in your voice, what feeling comes up first?

case-jason.text: [Anxious] A friend did not reply, and I kept wondering what I did wrong.
case-jason.suggestion: When you wonder what you did wrong, what feeling comes with that question?

case-jason.text: [Quietly] If someone laughs across the room, I assume it is about me.
case-jason.suggestion: What happens inside when you think the laugh is about you?

case-jason.text: [Hesitant] I keep my eyes on the table so people will not ask me anything.
case-jason.suggestion: When looking up feels risky, what feeling comes up around being seen?

case-jason.text: [Anxious] After meetings I replay one sentence for hours and feel my face heat up.
case-jason.suggestion: As that sentence comes back to you now, what do you notice inside?

case-jason.text: [Quietly] At parties I track the exit before I even know who is in the room.
case-jason.suggestion: When your attention goes to the exit, what feeling are you trying to get away from?

case-jason.text: [Hesitant] Someone smiled at me in the hallway, and I could not tell if it was friendly or awkward.
case-jason.suggestion: When you cannot tell what the smile means, what do you notice inside?

case-jason.text: [Anxious] I say I am busy before small talk can show how awkward I am.
case-jason.suggestion: When small talk feels about to expose you, what feeling comes forward first?

case-jason.text: [Quietly] Sunday nights feel heavy, like everyone else has a life waiting for them.
case-jason.suggestion: When that Sunday heaviness arrives, what feeling comes with the thought of belonging?

case-jason.text: [Uncertain] A colleague saved me a seat. I felt something, but then I was too busy trying to sit down normally to notice it.
case-jason.suggestion: What do you notice now as you picture the seat they saved for you?

case-jason.text: [Low voice] I typed a message to a friend, then deleted it. It only said I was having a rough day. Somehow that was too much.
case-jason.suggestion: What feels most difficult about letting your friend see that message?

case-laura.text: [Slow and flat] Most days feel muted, and I cannot tell if I am sad or just numb.
case-laura.suggestion: What is that muted feeling like in you right now?

case-laura.text: [Fearful] The neighbors argued in the hallway, and I spent the rest of the night acting like it was nothing.
case-laura.suggestion: Just beneath the acting-like-nothing, what feeling is closest?

case-laura.text: [Tense and guarded] When someone is kind to me, I get suspicious and then feel bad for being suspicious.
case-laura.suggestion: As kindness arrives and suspicion follows, what do you notice first in yourself?

case-laura.text: [Flat and guarded] Even gentle touch on my shoulder startles me before I can think who it is.
case-laura.suggestion: At the first startle, what do you feel before thought comes in?

case-laura.text: [Distant] At night I pour wine before I have decided whether I actually want it.
case-laura.suggestion: In the second before the wine, what are you moving away from?

case-laura.text: [Tense and guarded] I wake up already planning how to get through the day without needing anyone.
case-laura.suggestion: What do you feel as you imagine needing someone today?

case-laura.text: [Slow and flat] Good news lands flat, and I do not know why I cannot enjoy it.
case-laura.suggestion: When good news lands flat, what is the flatness like from the inside?

case-laura.text: [Distant] Sometimes a song from when I was married comes on, and sadness shows up before I can turn it off.
case-laura.suggestion: Before you turn the sadness off, what is it asking for?

case-laura.text: [Tense and guarded] I apologize for needing comfort, as if asking for it will get me in trouble.
case-laura.suggestion: When asking for comfort feels dangerous, what do you notice in yourself?

case-laura.text: [Flat and guarded] I skip anything with fighting and tell people I just do not like those movies.
case-laura.suggestion: Imagining the real reason spoken aloud, what feeling comes first?

case-laura.text: [Guarded] My friend sat beside me without asking questions. I didn't mind it as much as I expected. That's the bit I can't explain.
case-laura.suggestion: What was that quiet company like for you?

case-laura.text: [Flat] I sorted the last of his things. It was just a practical job. But afterwards I couldn't settle, even though everything was finally tidy.
case-laura.suggestion: What do you notice in that unsettled feeling right now?

case-carlos.text: [Defensive] When my foreman questions me in front of the crew, I laugh it off but cannot drop it.
case-carlos.suggestion: What do you notice inside as you recall your foreman questioning you?

case-carlos.text: [Tense] After an argument, I keep thinking of what I should have said, even when I know it will make things worse.
case-carlos.suggestion: While those replies keep coming, what are they trying to answer inside you?

case-carlos.text: [Fearful] If I back down, it feels like people will stop respecting me.
case-carlos.suggestion: When respect feels at risk, what do you feel in the sharpest place?

case-carlos.text: [Ashamed] I keep seeing my boy flinch when I raised my voice, and I do not want to look straight at it.
case-carlos.suggestion: Holding the image of his flinch for one second, what feeling comes up?

case-carlos.text: [Mistrustful] When the house gets quiet after a fight, I get more tense than when we were yelling.
case-carlos.suggestion: In the quiet after the fight, what starts happening inside?

case-carlos.text: [Tense] I say I do not care what people think, but one look can ruin my whole day.
case-carlos.suggestion: When that one look ruins the day, where does it hit?

case-carlos.text: [Defensive] My father used to say feelings make men useless, and I still hear that when my wife asks me to talk.
case-carlos.suggestion: Hearing that old rule now, what do you feel toward yourself?

case-carlos.text: [Angry, clenching fists] When another man talks down to me, I cannot tell if I am angry or embarrassed.
case-carlos.suggestion: As he talks down to you, what arrives first: anger, embarrassment, or something else?

case-carlos.text: [Tense and angry] After an argument, I tell myself I am over it, but I stay keyed up for hours.
case-carlos.suggestion: After the argument is over outside, what is still running inside?

case-carlos.text: [Vulnerable] What I want most is for my family to feel safe with me.
case-carlos.suggestion: When you say safe, what happens in you around that wish?

case-carlos.text: [Tense] My daughter asked me to lower my voice. I did. But something happened inside before I did, and I don't know what to call it.
case-carlos.suggestion: What do you notice as you return to the moment she asked you?

case-carlos.text: [Quiet, frowning] The men asked for my advice instead of just doing what I said. I liked it, actually. Then I felt uncomfortable about liking it.
case-carlos.suggestion: What felt good about being asked for your advice?

case-nina.text: [Tired] When I ask for help, guilt rushes in and I want to take it back.
case-nina.suggestion: As guilt rushes in, what does it tell you about yourself?

case-nina.text: [Guilty] I complain that no one helps, but I also redo things when they try.
case-nina.suggestion: When help comes in a way you cannot direct, what happens inside?

case-nina.text: [Torn] When I say no, I explain so much that I almost take it back.
case-nina.suggestion: As the no starts disappearing, what do you feel in that moment?

case-nina.text: [Guilty] When I rest, a voice calls me lazy before I have even caught my breath.
case-nina.suggestion: When the word lazy hits, where do you feel it most?

case-nina.text: [Apologetic] I apologize before asking for help, like my need is already too much.
case-nina.suggestion: When the need feels too big, what happens in how you meet yourself?

case-nina.text: [Torn] By afternoon I realize I agreed to three things I never wanted to do.
case-nina.suggestion: Saying you did not want them, what do you notice inside?

case-nina.text: [Tired] I compare myself to other moms and decide I have failed some test everyone else understands.
case-nina.suggestion: At the moment you decide you failed the test, what feeling comes up?

case-nina.text: [Guilty] I dream of being taken care of and then feel selfish for wanting it.
case-nina.suggestion: Before the selfish voice arrives, what is it like to let someone care for you?

case-nina.text: [Torn] I say it is easier if I do it myself, then spend the evening angry that nobody helped.
case-nina.suggestion: Under the anger after doing it yourself, what feeling is there?

case-nina.text: [Tired] I crash on the sofa at night after holding everyone together all day.
case-nina.suggestion: When you stop holding everyone together, what do you meet in yourself?

case-nina.text: [Hesitant] A colleague offered to take one of my tasks. I almost said yes. Then I heard myself saying it was no trouble, and I felt cross afterwards.
case-nina.suggestion: What did you want to say in that moment before 'no trouble' came out?

case-nina.text: [Apologetic] Everyone had a lovely Sunday. I organised it. When they asked whether I'd enjoyed it, I couldn't answer without wanting to cry.
case-nina.suggestion: What comes up as you give yourself room to answer that now?

case-aisha.text: [Panicked] If a reply does not come after I open up, I start thinking I was stupid to trust them.
case-aisha.suggestion: What feeling comes up as trusting starts to feel stupid?

case-aisha.text: [Desperate] I go from please do not leave to leave me alone in seconds.
case-aisha.suggestion: Just before it flips, what feeling is too painful to remain near?

case-aisha.text: [Desperate] I do not know what I feel today; everything is too much and also kind of blank.
case-aisha.suggestion: When it is both too much and blank, what feeling is easiest to notice first?

case-aisha.text: [Desperate] When you look down to write notes, I start wondering what you are really thinking about me.
case-aisha.suggestion: What happens inside as you imagine what I might be thinking?

case-aisha.text: [Panicked] When I talk about scratching, I want to make it sound casual so you will not overreact.
case-aisha.suggestion: What feeling comes up as you try to make it sound casual?

case-aisha.text: [Desperate] If you cancel a session, I do not want to come back and be dropped twice.
case-aisha.suggestion: What do you feel as you imagine me cancelling a session?

case-aisha.text: [Tearful] Kindness makes me cry, and then I want to get away from it.
case-aisha.suggestion: What is the first feeling that comes up when kindness reaches you?

case-aisha.text: [Desperate] I test people after they get close to see whether they care enough to stay.
case-aisha.suggestion: As you picture a test, what fear are you trying to answer inside?

case-aisha.text: [Ashamed] After I lash out, I hate myself so much I can barely stand being in my own skin.
case-aisha.suggestion: When that self-hate hits, what feeling is hardest to stay near?

case-aisha.text: [Panicked] At the end I say goodbye like it is fine, and then I leave angry for needing you.
case-aisha.suggestion: What feeling is under the anger as you leave?

case-aisha.text: [Guarded, then softer] I don't want to need your opinion. But when you said you hadn't decided for me, I felt worse, not better. I don't understand that.
case-aisha.suggestion: What was hardest to hear in my saying I hadn't decided for you?

case-aisha.text: [Quickly, then pausing] I wanted to send another message, and I didn't. Everyone calls that progress. I'm still trying to work out what I was left feeling.
case-aisha.suggestion: What do you notice in the feeling that stayed after you put the phone down?

case-david.text: [Controlled] When she calls me cold, I want to dismiss her, but it stays with me later.
case-david.suggestion: What feeling is there when it stays with you later?

case-david.text: [Controlled] If I am not winning, I feel hollow, like there is nothing solid under me.
case-david.suggestion: When winning is not there, what feeling comes with that hollowness?

case-david.text: [Defensive] I start listing achievements when I feel judged by my wife.
case-david.suggestion: What feeling are you trying not to show when you list achievements?

case-david.text: [Controlled] Praise from my boss feels good for a second, and then I start wondering what he wants.
case-david.suggestion: As praise turns into suspicion, what feeling starts to move inside?

case-david.text: [Dismissive] Admitting I am wrong makes my face burn like everyone can see through me.
case-david.suggestion: When admitting you are wrong feels exposing, what feeling comes up?

case-david.text: [Avoidant] When the talk gets emotional, I check my phone so I do not have to look exposed.
case-david.suggestion: As you reach for the phone, what feeling are you moving away from?

case-david.text: [Controlled] When the kids push back at dinner, I hear myself sounding like my father.
case-david.suggestion: What feeling comes up as you hear that resemblance?

case-david.text: [Distant] Since the affair, I cannot tell whether I feel guilty or just irritated that everyone keeps bringing it up.
case-david.suggestion: When guilt and irritation sit that close, what do you notice inside?

case-david.text: [Embarrassed] I want someone to notice what I do without making me beg for credit.
case-david.suggestion: When the credit does not come, what feeling comes up?

case-david.text: [Wounded but sharp] I hate being ordinary at work in front of everyone, like it means I have disappeared.
case-david.suggestion: When 'ordinary' starts to feel like disappearing, what feeling shows up?

case-david.text: [Controlled] I didn't correct my colleague in front of the team. It was the sensible decision. I was preoccupied with it for hours afterwards, though.
case-david.suggestion: What did holding back that correction feel like for you?

case-david.text: [Quiet, guarded] My wife thanked me for listening. There was nothing particularly insightful about what I said. Her thanking me felt strangely difficult to take.
case-david.suggestion: What is difficult about receiving her thanks just for listening?

case-marcus.text: [Slow and flat] Most days I am numb and then a wave hits out of nowhere.
case-marcus.suggestion: As you describe that wave, what do you notice in yourself now?

case-marcus.text: [Hypervigilant] After nightmares, I do not know what is real enough to talk about and what I should leave alone.
case-marcus.suggestion: As you decide what to leave alone, what happens inside?

case-marcus.text: [Quiet and guarded] In the grocery store I stay near exits because the aisles feel too closed in.
case-marcus.suggestion: When the aisles feel closed in, what feeling comes up?

case-marcus.text: [Low voice] After dark I cannot tell if the silence is peaceful or if it is closing in.
case-marcus.suggestion: What happens inside as the silence shifts from peaceful to closing in?

case-marcus.text: [Low voice] I sit in the car after work because going upstairs means being alone with whatever is there.
case-marcus.suggestion: What feeling is waiting when you picture opening the apartment door?

case-marcus.text: [Quiet and guarded] I keep the lights low and ignore calls so the world stays far away.
case-marcus.suggestion: What happens inside as you imagine answering one of those calls?

case-marcus.text: [Flat] When something good happens, I wait for the part where it gets taken back.
case-marcus.suggestion: What feeling comes up while you wait for it to be taken back?

case-marcus.text: [Hypervigilant] Sudden sounds in the stairwell make me jump and then scan for danger.
case-marcus.suggestion: Right after the jump, what feeling takes over?

case-marcus.text: [Quiet and guarded] I do not remember the last time I really laughed without checking myself.
case-marcus.suggestion: As you say you cannot remember laughing, what feeling comes closest to the surface?

case-marcus.text: [Flat] I tell myself I am better off alone because closeness always costs something.
case-marcus.suggestion: When closeness starts to feel costly, what feeling shows up inside?

case-marcus.text: [Low voice] I stayed when the neighbour started talking. Usually I leave. Afterwards I was restless. That's all I know.
case-marcus.suggestion: What can you notice about that restlessness here, without needing to explain it?

case-marcus.text: [Guarded] You remembered the date. I wasn't expecting that. Don't know whether I like it.
case-marcus.suggestion: What is it like, right now, that I remembered?

case-arne.text: [Hesitates] There’s a feeling when I see her empty chair. I can’t quite name it.
case-arne.suggestion: What do you notice as you look at that chair in your mind now?

case-arne.text: [Thoughtful] The workshop was good, then something changed on the way home.
case-arne.suggestion: What was happening when you first noticed the change?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I say I’m fine when Emma asks. It comes out before I think.
case-arne.suggestion: What do you notice just before you tell her you’re fine?

case-arne.text: [Frowning] I get tight across here when they say I should move on.
case-arne.suggestion: What is that tightness like as you remember those words?

case-arne.text: [Unsure] I don’t know what I wanted Tom to do when I went quiet.
case-arne.suggestion: What would have felt helpful from him in that moment?

case-arne.text: [Puzzled] I can manage breakfast. Dinner is different somehow.
case-arne.suggestion: What feels different about sitting down to dinner?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] Hearing that song did something to me.
case-arne.suggestion: What did you notice when the song began?

case-arne.text: [Thoughtful] I felt good helping Emma. Not just distracted.
case-arne.suggestion: What was good about helping her?

case-arne.text: [Hesitates] I keep saying I should have done more.
case-arne.suggestion: When you say “more,” what are you picturing?

case-arne.text: [Uncertain] There was relief that night. I don’t really understand it.
case-arne.suggestion: What was the relief about, as far as you can tell?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] The house feels strange when I’ve had a nice day.
case-arne.suggestion: What feels strange about coming home after a nice day?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I want something to be different, but I don’t know what.
case-arne.suggestion: If we take one ordinary evening, what would you want more room for?

case-arne.text: [Hesitant] When I say the quiet is nice, something in me objects.
case-arne.suggestion: What does that objection seem to say?

case-arne.text: [Thoughtful] I want Emma there, but not fussing. It’s hard to explain.
case-arne.suggestion: What kind of being together would feel right to you?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] The relief and guilt seem tangled.
case-arne.suggestion: If we take the relief first, what were you relieved from?

case-arne.text: [Dry laugh] I keep tidying a room nobody uses. Not sure what I’m doing.
case-arne.suggestion: What happens for you when you go into that room?

case-arne.text: [Frowning] “Moving on” sounds wrong. I can’t say exactly why.
case-arne.suggestion: What do those words seem to ask you to leave behind?

case-arne.text: [Unsure] I went quiet when Tom asked about the workshop.
case-arne.suggestion: What was going on in that quiet moment?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I felt angry at the photograph. Then I felt absurd.
case-arne.suggestion: Before judging it, what was the anger about in that moment?

case-arne.text: [Hesitant] Sometimes company makes me lonelier.
case-arne.suggestion: What happens in the company that brings the loneliness closer?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I don’t know if that tightness is guilt or just being tired.
case-arne.suggestion: What helps you tell them apart, if anything, as you notice it now?

case-arne.text: [Uncertain] Enjoying the walk felt fine until I thought of her.
case-arne.suggestion: What changed when Eva came to mind?

case-arne.text: [Thoughtful] The house feels both familiar and not mine.
case-arne.suggestion: What feels familiar, and what feels less yours now?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I want things to change, but some changes feel wrong.
case-arne.suggestion: Which change are you thinking of when you say “wrong”?

case-arne.text: [Firmly] It isn’t guilt, not quite. Don’t offer me another name yet.
case-arne.suggestion: What would you like me to understand about it before we look for a name?

case-arne.text: [Watchful] The empty chair isn’t always sad. Sometimes it’s just a chair.
case-arne.suggestion: What is it like today, as you think of it?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I want help, but questions can start feeling like an examination.
case-arne.suggestion: What would make our conversation feel less like an examination right now?

case-arne.text: [Careful] Relief from the care, relief from watching her suffer—they’re different.
case-arne.suggestion: Which part would you like us to understand first?

case-arne.text: [Dryly] Don’t ask where it is in my body. I’d rather use words.
case-arne.suggestion: What words come closest, even if they’re unfinished?

case-arne.text: [Hesitant] I’m not sure whether I miss her or the person I was with her.
case-arne.suggestion: What feels different between those two kinds of missing?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I thought changing the bedroom would help. I slept better, but I don’t know how I feel about it.
case-arne.suggestion: What do you notice when you picture the changed room now?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I said lonely. Now it feels less true. Maybe I was borrowing the word.
case-arne.suggestion: What is closer to your experience as you notice it now?

case-arne.text: [Watchful] You might see the workshop as a new beginning. I’m not sure I do.
case-arne.suggestion: What place does the workshop have for you, in your own terms?

case-arne.text: [Frowning] I wanted Emma there, and I hated being watched. Neither is the whole thing.
case-arne.suggestion: What would help us hear the part that’s missing from those two descriptions?

case-arne.text: [Careful] I can talk about that evening, but not the hospital today.
case-arne.suggestion: Where in the evening would you like to begin?

case-arne.text: [Uncertain] I’m not sure there is a feeling to uncover. I’m just tired.
case-arne.suggestion: What would be most useful with that tiredness today?

case-mia.text: [Puzzled] Something happens when Alex reaches for the bag.
case-mia.suggestion: What do you notice in that moment?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] Putting the pencil down feels different from stopping any other task.
case-mia.suggestion: What is different about stopping the drawing?

case-mia.text: [Unsure] I can’t quite say why “you look well” bothers me.
case-mia.suggestion: What do you hear in those words?

case-mia.text: [Thoughtful] Sam’s question stayed with me all evening.
case-mia.suggestion: What about his question stayed with you?

case-mia.text: [Hesitant] I want to ask Ella for something. I don’t know what.
case-mia.suggestion: What would you like to be different when she visits?

case-mia.text: [Confused] I was relieved to cancel, but it wasn’t only relief.
case-mia.suggestion: What else was there with the relief?

case-mia.text: [Pauses] I didn’t like how the meeting ended.
case-mia.suggestion: Which part of the ending stands out to you?

case-mia.text: [Unsure] I feel odd accepting help with the plants.
case-mia.suggestion: What feels odd about accepting that help?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I miss work, but not every part of it.
case-mia.suggestion: Which part do you find yourself missing?

case-mia.text: [Frowning] I keep calling myself difficult.
case-mia.suggestion: What does “difficult” mean to you here?

case-mia.text: [Reflective] I want Alex nearby, but sometimes I move away.
case-mia.suggestion: What happens just before you move away?

case-mia.text: [Uncertain] I don’t know what a good day means anymore.
case-mia.suggestion: What would make a day feel good to you now?

case-mia.text: [Hesitates] I said thank you, but something tightened between us.
case-mia.suggestion: What was happening for you as you thanked him?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I didn’t want the offer to stop. Just... something about how it came.
case-mia.suggestion: What about the way he offered felt difficult?

case-mia.text: [Half-smiles] I called the drawing “good enough” very quickly.
case-mia.suggestion: What was happening just before you called it good enough?

case-mia.text: [Uncertain] Being noticed at work felt good until it didn’t.
case-mia.suggestion: When did it stop feeling good?

case-mia.text: [Reflective] I’m not sure whether I wanted company or help that evening.
case-mia.suggestion: What did you most want Alex to understand about that evening?

case-mia.text: [Uneasy] I feel guilty after a good day, which makes no sense.
case-mia.suggestion: What do you find yourself saying to yourself after a good day?

case-mia.text: [Frowning] I can ask Sam for the chair. Asking Ella is different.
case-mia.suggestion: What changes when the person you ask is Ella?

case-mia.text: [Pauses] I said I didn’t mind handing over the tour. I’m not sure I meant it.
case-mia.suggestion: What part of handing it over did you mind?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I want the help, but not that look.
case-mia.suggestion: What do you see in that look?

case-mia.text: [Unsure] Saying no felt right. Then it felt mean.
case-mia.suggestion: What made the no start to feel mean?

case-mia.text: [Thoughtful] I used to know what counted as contributing. Now it’s muddled.
case-mia.suggestion: What would feel like a real contribution to you now?

case-mia.text: [Hesitates] When they praise me for coping, I go quiet.
case-mia.suggestion: What happens inside that quiet?

case-mia.text: [Hesitates] He asked first. There was still something wrong in the moment.
case-mia.suggestion: Which part of the moment stands out, even if you don’t know why yet?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I went quiet. Not to punish him. I don’t know what it was.
case-mia.suggestion: What do you remember just before the quiet came?

case-mia.text: [Corrects] “Losing independence” isn’t quite it. That phrase misses something.
case-mia.suggestion: What does that phrase leave out for you?

case-mia.text: [Thoughtful] I was glad Sam noticed. Later I wished he hadn’t.
case-mia.suggestion: What changed for you between those moments?

case-mia.text: [Tired] I can’t separate fatigue from sadness today. I don’t want to try hard at it.
case-mia.suggestion: What could we talk about without asking you to separate them?

case-mia.text: [Flatly] I left the drawing out. There isn’t a story to tell about it yet.
case-mia.suggestion: What, if anything, draws your attention to it now?

case-mia.text: [Uneasy] I know what I wanted him to stop. I’m less sure what I wanted instead.
case-mia.suggestion: What would have felt different enough in that moment?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] The anger isn’t all at Ella. I don’t know where the rest goes.
case-mia.suggestion: What else comes into view when you say it isn’t all at her?

case-mia.text: [Half-smiles] It felt like being me, but I can’t give you an inspiring account of it.
case-mia.suggestion: What ordinary detail made it feel like being you?

case-mia.text: [Hesitant] I want company tonight. I’m not sure I want conversation.
case-mia.suggestion: What kind of company are you picturing?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] The praise bothered me, although some of it was true.
case-mia.suggestion: Which part felt right, and where did it stop fitting?

case-mia.text: [Corrects, then pauses] It wasn’t fear. Or not only fear.
case-mia.suggestion: How would you describe the part that “fear” doesn’t quite catch?

case-nora.text: [Puzzled] I went quiet afterwards. I don’t quite know why.
case-nora.suggestion: What do you remember from the moment the quiet came?

case-nora.text: [Unsure] Something about Max helping didn’t feel right.
case-nora.suggestion: What about the help felt wrong to you?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] The word “really” stayed with me.
case-nora.suggestion: What did that word add to the question for you?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I didn’t want to look at my drawings.
case-nora.suggestion: What was it like to see them after that meeting?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] I want Ben to understand something. I don’t know how to say it.
case-nora.suggestion: What would you most want him to understand?

case-nora.text: [Reflective] Lina listened differently.
case-nora.suggestion: What felt different in how she listened?

case-nora.text: [Uncertain] I keep calling myself oversensitive.
case-nora.suggestion: What are you judging yourself for when you use that word?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I’m not sure what support I wanted from Adam.
case-nora.suggestion: What would have felt helpful when you came home?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] I liked talking about the photographs. It mattered somehow.
case-nora.suggestion: What mattered about that conversation?

case-nora.text: [Frowning] Speaking up feels risky.
case-nora.suggestion: What risk feels most important to you?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] I want to belong there, but not like this.
case-nora.suggestion: What would belonging look like on terms you could accept?

case-nora.text: [Unsure] I can’t tell what I need today.
case-nora.suggestion: Which part of the day would you like us to understand first?

case-nora.text: [Hesitates] I was glad Max said something. Then I wanted to disappear.
case-nora.suggestion: What changed as he kept speaking?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I know the words were wrong. I’m less sure why I couldn’t work afterwards.
case-nora.suggestion: What came up when you turned back to the drawings?

case-nora.text: [Unsure] I’m angry about the meeting and something else I can’t name.
case-nora.suggestion: What else is close as you remember the meeting?

case-nora.text: [Reflective] The interruption might have been ordinary. I didn’t feel ordinary in it.
case-nora.suggestion: What was happening for you in that moment?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I said I didn’t need anything from Adam. That wasn’t quite true.
case-nora.suggestion: What did you want that was hard to ask for?

case-nora.text: [Half-smiles] I keep making the story funny. It wasn’t funny then.
case-nora.suggestion: What happens just before the joke arrives?

case-nora.text: [Uneasy] I want to be heard, but not in that meeting.
case-nora.suggestion: What makes that meeting the wrong place for you?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] I liked being asked about the photographs more than I expected.
case-nora.suggestion: What was different about being asked that?

case-nora.text: [Uncertain] I don’t know whether I’m protecting myself or giving up.
case-nora.suggestion: What does each of those possibilities mean to you?

case-nora.text: [Frowning] I want credit, but I get uneasy imagining the announcement.
case-nora.suggestion: Which part of the announcement feels uneasy?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I’m less angry with Lina, but I’m still explaining to her.
case-nora.suggestion: What do you hope the next explanation will give you?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] Leaving the job is a thought, not a plan. It means something, though.
case-nora.suggestion: What does that thought offer you when it comes?

case-nora.text: [Hesitates] I kept making the words softer. I’m not sure whom that helped.
case-nora.suggestion: What happened for you as you softened them?

case-nora.text: [Corrects] “Not belonging” isn’t quite it. I know I belong.
case-nora.suggestion: What does that phrase miss about your experience?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I thanked Max and then avoided him. I don’t have a tidy reason.
case-nora.suggestion: What do you remember wanting just after you thanked him?

case-nora.text: [Unsure] Today’s interruption set something off. I can’t name it fairly yet.
case-nora.suggestion: Which part of the moment can you describe without deciding its cause?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] I want the work seen, but not every part of me seen.
case-nora.suggestion: What would you want kept private within that recognition?

case-nora.text: [Flatly] I left the drawings on the desk. There isn’t a story about it yet.
case-nora.suggestion: What, if anything, draws your attention to them now?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I wanted Ben’s response. Then I didn’t want to hear it.
case-nora.suggestion: What changed as the possibility of a response got closer?

case-nora.text: [Tired] I know what happened. I can’t give you a feeling word today.
case-nora.suggestion: What could we use instead of a feeling word to understand today?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] Staying and leaving both feel wrong in different ways.
case-nora.suggestion: Which cost would you like us to understand first?

case-nora.text: [Softly] I enjoyed dinner. The next feeling wasn’t exactly guilt.
case-nora.suggestion: How would you describe what “guilt” doesn’t quite capture?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I want company tonight, but not a listener waiting for the story.
case-nora.suggestion: What kind of company are you picturing?

case-nora.text: [Corrects, pauses] I wasn’t afraid. Or not mainly afraid.
case-nora.suggestion: What was more central than fear in that moment?
